topic_dispositions.disposition: Retain excretion versus egestion and systemic homeostasis.
Retain organ cooperation; correct carbon dioxide to metabolic waste and distinguish sweat from renal nitrogen handling.
Retain waste classes; correct adult water claim and distinguish dietary salt loads from metabolic generation.
Retain ammonia/ammonium and toxicity; hepatic detoxification replaces the erroneous ammonia-to-uric-acid chain.
Retain hepatic urea cycle and renal excretion; qualify nitrogen transport hazard and toxicity.
Correct uric acid to purine metabolism and limited, pH-dependent solubility; reject complete insolubility.
Retain creatinine/muscle confounding; omit routine crystallization and unsupported sex-specific production ranges; BUN alone is not confirmatory.
Correct urethra to ureter in kidney-to-bladder route; retain the full urinary tract.
Retain bean shape and approximate 10–12 cm adult example; omit fixed mass/width/thickness diagnostic ranges.
Separate cortex and medulla from sinus; retain cortical columns and papilla/calyx drainage.
Define a multicellular nephron, with variable order-of-million counts; narrow inconsistent counts are not constants.
Distinguish reversible injury, permanent nephron loss and renal reserve; reject inevitable immediate total failure.
Define sinus contents and distinguish the collecting space from functional tissue layers.
Retain corpuscle, proximal tubule, loop, distal tubule and collecting routes, including Bellini ducts and calyces.
Retain volume, electrolytes, osmolality, acid-base and waste functions; qualify bilirubin routes and molecular forms.
EPO responds to oxygen-sensitive signaling, not direct RBC counting; correct thrombopoietin source using liver-primary evidence.
Renin is an enzyme distinct from angiotensin; RAAS does not automatically prevent hypertension.
Correct activation direction from 25-hydroxyvitamin D to active 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D.
Retain the usual lower right kidney position and liver relationship.
Answer uromodulin synthesis, defense and salt handling with species limits; omit undefined 60–70% gene statistic.
Place all corpuscles in cortex, including juxtamedullary ones; qualify counts and omit a fixed 85% proportion.
Separate afferent→glomerular lumen→efferent blood route from the filtered branch.
Explain fenestrated endothelium plus glycocalyx; reject blood-cell passage and a universal molecular cutoff.
Retain collagen IV/laminin and conventional EM layer orientation; distinguish preparation contrast from independent filters.
Reject all-proteins-negative and charge-only explanations; include mouse agrin/perlecan counterexample with limits.
Explain the integrated barrier and binding limits for lipid and hemoglobin claims; bridge small-solute filtration to reabsorption.
Separate parietal/visceral capsule layers and capsular space.
Distinguish podocytes from their foot processes and nephrin-containing slit diaphragms; reject a universal 10 nm sieve.
Retain mesangial support/local clearance; reject unsupported slit-patrolling protein-chopping behavior.
Define GFR as bilateral ultrafiltrate volume/time, distinct from whole-blood flow and urine flow.
Correct actual slide plasma label and nonconserving flow diagram: 1,200=1,075+125, with 500 efferent plasma and 575 retained cells.
Define coefficient, area/permeability and explicit reflection assumption; reject universal flow/systemic-pressure proportionality.
Choose capillary-to-capsular positive direction and derive hydrostatic/oncotic signs separately.
Calculate illustrative 55−15−30=10 mmHg; distinguish capsular hydrostatic pressure from plasma oncotic pressure and reject Hz.
Explain afferent versus moderate/severe efferent effects; keep the two-resistor analogy separate from a nephron/GFR model.
Disposition every mediator name; distinguish intracellular cAMP, PGE₂/PGF₂ slide wording and caption error; omit a universal drug/direction table.
Separate tubular macula-densa salt sensing, vascular granular renin cells and lacis region; JGA is outside the GBM.
Explain renin enzymatic processing and rabbit macula-densa PGE₂ evidence; omit the unqualified amino-acid count.
Qualify proteinuria/edema: foam is not diagnostic, protein leakage need not raise GFR, and other variables change.
Solve both barrier questions and the slide-only right ureter obstruction question, including capsular pressure, one-kidney scaling and contralateral/time assumptions.

scientific_issue_dispositions.status: corrected in draft; independent review pending
scientific_issue_dispositions.detail: The actual slide labels 1,200 mL plasma/min and uses nonconserving 1,200/575/125 routes. The draft explicitly corrects both with RPF=RBF(1−H), FF=GFR/RPF, and 500 mL/min efferent plasma +575 retained cells=1,075 efferent blood. No caption-only error claim.

limitations: Pressure relation assumes a fully effective oncotic difference, fixed Kf and normal-low-protein capsular fluid; no longitudinal capillary concentration or feedback dynamics.
Two-resistor analogy has no filtration side branch and is not combined into a nephron prediction.
Observed SEM species and detailed preparation are unreported; the literal instrument 10.0U annotation is retained without independently calibrated physical dimensions.
Original gross/nephron/barrier panels have separate illustrative scales, colors and proportions; they are not registered to the SEM or claimed as specimen measurements.
